description.value: A McDonald's fast-food restaurant located in Nanaimo, BC, serving the full Canadian McDonald's menu including burgers, chicken, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. As a well-known chain stop along Vancouver Island's cycling corridors, it offers a reliable and quick resupply point for touring cyclists needing calories on the road. Takeout is available, and the McValue meal lineup provides accessible fuel at a predictable price point.
